testcase.name: PostgreSQL 17: case-insensitive login creates independent256-bit tokens/hash-only sessions and minimal scoped Self
PostgreSQL 17: wrong/unknown/inactive/corrupt and short CurrentPassword failures are generic; spaces are significant
PostgreSQL 17: strict login allowlist and scalar CurrentPassword bounds validate before attempts or hashing
PostgreSQL 17: username limit10 ignores case/IP; successes and restart preserve limits; exact15min boundary resets
PostgreSQL 17: IP limit30 spans usernames and successful login; mapped IPv4 shares bucket; expired buckets reset
PostgreSQL 17: reads do not renew idle; CSRF activity renews only before exact60min expiry
PostgreSQL 17: activity never extends12h absolute expiry; lowered configured lifetimes and clock regression fail safely
PostgreSQL 17: forced gate limits Self summaries; scoped grants are current, archived Lead survives; logout revokes one session
PostgreSQL 17: auth-version/deactivation/role/reset revocation compose atomically and rollback preserves sessions
PostgreSQL 17: login replaces presented old session without fixation; revocation race never creates a session
